convert_moco_model: convert a pycls pretrained moco model to mmdet style by remapping state dict keys
run_moco_conversion: run the moco model converter to transform encoder_q keys for mmdet compatibility
run_swav_check: run the self-supervised model converter with swav mode to confirm no key conversion needed
review_moco_convert: review the moco_convert function that strips module.encoder_q prefix from state dict keys
summarize_main: summarize the main function that parses args and dispatches moco or swav conversion logic
